departments.name: Corporate Strategy & Planning
departments.scope: Corporate strategy, business planning, forecasting, strategic initiatives, performance management and executive reporting

competencies.name: Strategic Analysis & Market Intelligence
competencies.definition: Analyse market, competitor, regulatory and macro trends to inform strategic choices.
behaviours: Collects market and competitor data from defined sources and keeps trackers up to date.
Analyses market share, growth and competitor moves and summarises implications for the company.
Frames strategic questions, combines multiple sources and recommends options with clear trade-offs.
Anticipates industry shifts and shapes the strategic agenda of senior management.

competencies.name: Business Planning & Target Setting
competencies.definition: Translate strategy into business plans, targets and resource allocation aligned with capital and risk appetite.
behaviours: Prepares planning templates and consolidates inputs from departments accurately.
Builds department and company plans, checks consistency of targets and challenges unrealistic inputs.
Leads the annual planning cycle and aligns targets with capital, risk appetite and resource constraints.
Sets the planning framework and negotiates enterprise targets with executives and shareholders.

competencies.name: Financial Forecasting & Scenario Modelling
competencies.definition: Build forecasts and scenarios for premium, loss ratio, combined ratio, capital and profit.
behaviours: Updates forecast models with actual results following defined steps.
Builds forecasts for premium, loss ratio and expenses and explains key assumptions.
Designs scenario and sensitivity analyses and quantifies the impact on profit and capital.
Owns the forecasting methodology and advises executives on strategic and capital decisions.

competencies.name: Performance Management & Executive Reporting
competencies.definition: Track strategic KPIs, analyse variances and present insights for executive decisions.
behaviours: Prepares KPI reports and dashboards on schedule with accurate data.
Analyses variances against plan and identifies drivers and follow-up actions.
Structures executive presentations that lead with conclusions and recommendations, and runs performance reviews.
Designs the enterprise performance management system and influences board-level decisions.

competencies.name: Strategic Project & Initiative Management
competencies.definition: Plan, deliver and track strategic initiatives so that they achieve their intended business benefits.
behaviours: Tracks project milestones, actions and issues in the project register and reports status on time.
Runs workstreams independently: plans, coordinates owners, flags risks and escalates delays.
Leads cross-functional strategic initiatives, manages dependencies and measures benefits against the business case.
Governs the strategic initiative portfolio, prioritises investment and steers transformation with executives.
